rows.author: C083
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2005-05-10, transmitted to on 2005-05-11 and received by the Senate on 2005-05-17
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE POLILLO-PANUKULAN PROVINCIAL ROAD IN THE MUNICIPALITIES OF POLILLO AND PANUKULAN, PROVINCE OF QUEZON INTO A NATIONAL ROAD AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE IMPROVEMENT AND MAINTENANCE THEREOF
rows.status: Substituted by HB04031

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09344) enacted on 2006-04-28
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENHANCING THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUVENILE JUSTICE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER RELATED PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Juvenile Justice Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Juvenile Justice Act of 2004.\" The bill emphasizes on the need to rehabilitate and reintegrate the youth offender into the mainstream of society in contrast with the traditional punitive approach to the delinquent act. Defines a child as a person below 18 years old and provides that no person below 15 years old shall be held criminally liable for committing an offense. Creates the Office of Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention within the Department of Justice to implement the juvenile justice system.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05065

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO DEFINE AND GUARANTEE PUBLIC SECTOR UNIONISM IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Public Sector Unionism Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Public Sector Unionism Act of 2004.\" The bill guarantees the right of government employees to self-organization, negotiation, collective bargaining, peaceful assembly and the right to strike.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE MAGNA CARTA FOR OLDER PERSONS
rows.title_short: Magna Carta for the Older Persons
rows.abstract: \"Magna Carta for Older Persons.\" The measure establishes the National Council for the Welfare of Older Persons, under the Office of the President, to direct all activities for the elderly. Provides for the rights, privileges, incentives and other benefits of older persons. Provides for social services, political and civil rights, transportation privileges, housing and tax incentives.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT LOWERING THE COSTS OF MEDICINES AND HEALTH CARE IN THE PHILIPPINES BY EXEMPTING THE SALE, IMPORTATION, PROCESSING, REPACKING OR MANUFACTURING OF: MEDICINES; PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS; MEDICAL, DENTAL AND HOSPITAL EQUIPMENT; AND RAW MATERIALS TO BE USED IN THE MANUFACTURE THEREOF; FROM ALL DUTIES AND TAXES
rows.abstract: Amends Section 103 of PD 1994 exempting from value-added tax medicines and hospital equipment to help lower the cost of health care.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT DIRECTING ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SCHOOLS OF HIGHER LEARNING TO CREDIT SUBJECTS ALREADY TAKEN BY A TRANSFERRING STUDENT, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Directs the Commission on Higher Education to prescribe the rules implementing this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING FOR A SYSTEM OF CREDITING THE UNITS OF ACADEMIC COURSES OFFICIALLY ENROLLED AND PASSED BY A TRANSFERRING STUDENT TO THE INSTITUTION OF HIGHER LEARNING WHERE HE INTENDS TO ENROLL
rows.title_short: Borderless Course Credit Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Borderless Course Credit Act of 2004\".  The bill provides that in case a student transfers from one institute of higher learning to another, whether public or private, the admitting school, after evaluation, shall credit all subjects enrolled and passed by the transferring student.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6963, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'AN ACT GRANTING SPECIAL FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE AND BENEFITS TO THE FAMILY OR BENEFICIARY OF ANY POLICE OR MILITARY PERSONNEL OR FIREMAN KILLED OR PERMANENTLY INCAPACITATED WHILE IN THE PERFORMANCE OF HIS DUTY OR BY REASON OF HIS OFFICE OR POSITION AND ALSO EXTENDING SCHOLARSHIP ASSISTANCE TO THE DEPENDENTS OF THEIR ACTIVE MEMBERS' AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to include the following as beneficiaries of RA 6963: families of Philippine National Police, Armed Forces of the Philippines, Bureau of Fire Protection and the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology personnel.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2007-01-31, transmitted to on 2007-02-06 and received by the Senate on 2007-02-06
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE POLITICAL PARTY SYSTEM
rows.title_short: Political Party Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Political Party Act of 2004.\" The bill aims to transform political parties from being personality-oriented to issue-oriented organizations. Provides that any member of the party changing his affiliation after being elected on his party's ticket should first resign from his elective position and seek a fresh mandate.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05877

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE MAGNA CARTA FOR THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE UNIFORMED AND NON-UNIFORMED PERSONNEL AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Magna Carta for the Philippine National Police Uniformed and Non-uniformed Personnel.
rows.abstract: \"Magna Carta for the Philippine National Police Uniformed and Non-uniformed Personnel.\"  The bill provides for the PNP organization, structure, prerequisite to entry, salaries, leave benefits, retirement, disciplinary measures and disability and death benefits.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-06

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-06
committee_action.remarks: Substite bill prepared by the Committee

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE RETIREMENT BENEFITS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 75 OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY- NINE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-FIVE ENTITLED, 'AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE UNDER A REORGANIZED DEPARTMENT OF INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT,' AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: PNP Retirement Benefits Act
rows.abstract: \"PNP Retirement Benefits Act.\" The bill provides that the retirement pay of the members of the PNP shall be equal to one month base pay and longevity pay of the grade next higher than the permanent grade last held, for every year of service, payable in one lump sum or a monthly retirement pay equal to 50% of the base pay.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: Printed copies distributed to members on 2007-02-05
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH A PROVIDENT PERSONAL SAVINGS PLAN KNOWN AS THE 'PERSONAL EQUITY AND RETIREMENT ACCOUNT'
rows.title_short: Personal Equity and Retirement Account (PERA) Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Personal Equity and Retirement Account (PERA) Act of 2004.\" The measure provides that an individual may open a retirement account with a trustee or a bank accredited by the Central Bank with a initial deposit of P20,000.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06078

Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2006-09-26
Approved by the Committee on 2006-11-21
Transmmitted to the Committee on Ways and Means on 2006-11-21

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING 'APPROVED, CERTIFIED AND ACCREDITED COURSES/SUBJECT' OPENED AND/OR OFFERED BY ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS AND IMPOSING STIFFER PENALTY FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.title_short: \"Courses Accreditation Act of 2004.\"
rows.abstract: \"Courses Accreditation Act of 2004.\" The measure mandates that before any academic course is offered by a school, approval shall be obtained from proper government authorities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PREVENT THE USE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS BY THE YOUTH
rows.title_short: Prevention of Youth Tobacco Use Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Prevention of Youth Tobacco Use Act of 2004.\" The bill prohibits any person under 18 years old to possess, smoke or consume tobacco in public. Imposes a fine of not more than P5,000 for violations of the proposed act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING THE EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN IN ANY PUBLIC OR PRIVATE UNDERTAKING OR OCCUPATION WHICH IS CONSIDERED HAZARDOUS TO HIS/HER LIFE, SAFETY, HEALTH AND MORALS, OR WHICH UNDULY INTERFERES WITH HIS/HER NORMAL DEVELOPMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill bans children from working in hazardous jobs that expose them to danger such as chemical radiation, fire, poison, explosives or bacteria. Prohibits children from working in hazardous jobs such as deep-sea fishing, farming, hunting, logging, mining, quarrying, machine-operation, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR ADDITIONAL BENEFITS AND PRIVILEGES TO PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS, AMENDING FOR THESE PURPOSES REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED FORTY-SIX HUNDRED SEVENTY (REPUBLIC ACT NO. 4670), OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE MAGNA CARTA FOR PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The measure grants hardship allowance equal to 25% of monthly salary to teachers exposed to danger due to distant locations, natural calamities or armed conflict. Allows teachers one-year study leave after three years of service to pursue graduate studies.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on 2007-02-07

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on 2007-02-07

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER STRENGTHENING VOLUNTARY ARBITRATION AS A PREFERENTIAL MODE OF LABOR DISPUTE SETTLEMENT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLES 260, 261, 262-A, 262-B AND 227 (F) OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 422, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill provides that in case the parties to a labor dispute fail to name and designate in advance a Voluntary Arbitrator, the Board shall, upon the request by any of the parties, designate one. It further states that failure of the Arbitrator to render an award or decision will cause the Board to remove his name from the list of accredited Arbitrators.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING THE COVERAGE OF THE EMPLOYEES COMPENSATION AND STATE INSURANCE FUND TO INCLUDE RETIRED EMPLOYEES AGED SEVENTY (70) AND BELOW WHO SUBSEQUENTLY REACQUIRED EMPLOYMENT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Expanding the Coverage of the Employees Compensation and State Insurance Fund to Include Retired Employees Aged Seventy (70) and Below
rows.abstract: Amends Article 168 of PD 442 (Labor Code) to include 70-year old employees in the coverage of the State Insurance Fund.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-08-07, transmitted to on 2006-08-14 and received by the Senate on 2006-08-14

second_reading.remarks: The Body adopted the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure.

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE YEARLY ALLOCATION FOR SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL ACTIVITIES (STA)
rows.title_short: Science and Technology Funding Act of 2001
rows.abstract: \"Science and Technology Funding Act of 2001.\" The bill provides for the allocation for scientific and technological activities to be gradually increased until it reaches the prescribe UNESCO norm of one percent of total GNP.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT RA09347 (Lapsed into law on 2006-07-27)
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLES 215 AND 216 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED, BY UPGRADING THE SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND RETIREMENT BENEFITS OF LABOR ARBITERS AND THE COMMISSIONERS OF THE NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS COMMISSION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the Chairman and members of the Commission to receive an annual salary equivalent to the allowances, retirement and other benefits of judges of municipal trial courts.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05015

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A DEPARTMENT OF FISHERIES AND AQUATIC RESOURCES, PROVIDING FOR ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Departmnet of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act of 2004.\" The bill creates the Department to manage, develop, protect, conserve and utilize all fisheries and aquatic resources except for municipal waters which shall be under the local government. It prescribes the jurisdiction of the Department, its powers and functions, structural organization, functions of its officials and creation of bureaus.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING VACATION AND SICK LEAVE BENEFITS OF GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill grants 30 days vacation leave and 30 days sick leave annually, with pay, to all employees of the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE MONTHLY PENSION OF RETIRED PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS AND NON-TEACHING PERSONNEL OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: (Same as HB00349)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-05-29, transmitted to on 2006-05-31 and received by the Senate on 2006-05-31
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING INCENTIVES TO SUBDIVISION HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATIONS TO DEVELOP AND MAINTAIN FORESTED AREAS WITHIN THEIR SUBDIVISIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: The Green Parks Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Green Parks Act of 2004.\" The measure requires homeowners' associations to set aside five percent of the total subdivision area for a green park.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04074

committee_action.action: Committee Report filed on 2005-03-31
committee_action.remarks: Please refer to Substitute Bill No. 4074 (CR No. 618)

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL BRANCHES, SUBDIVISIONS, INSTRUMENTALITIES, AND AGENCIES OF THE GOVERNMENT, INCLUDING GOVERNMENT-OWNED OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS OR THEIR SUBSIDIARIES TO DIVULGE THE IDENTITY OF HIRED FOREIGN CONSULTANTS, THE NATURE OF THEIR WORK AND THEIR COMPENSATION, PERKS, AND OTHER PRIVILEGES, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES IN CASE OF VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: The measure aims to inform the public how much money the government pays to its consultants by requiring all agencies to report to Congress the identity, salary and nature of work of these consultants.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on 2007-02-07

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on 2007-02-07

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT ALL EXPENDITURES FOR THE PAYMENT OF FOREIGN DEBTS BE INCLUDED IN THE ANNUAL GENERAL APPROPRIATIONS ACT
rows.abstract: The bill claims that the government is unable to review and assess debts which may have been incurred against public interest and requires all foreign debt payments to be included in the annual budget for approval by Congress.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL PROGRAM FOR FILIPINO GIFTED AND SCIENCE ORIENTED CHILDREN, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Gifted and Science-Oriented Children Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Gifted and Science-Oriented Children Act of 2004.\" The bill defines a gifted child as three to 16 years old exhibiting advance intelligence in the following areas: verbal/linguistic, logical/mathematical. body/kinesthetic, visual/spatial, musical/rhythmic and leadership. Establishes a Center for gifted children to support them, train their teachers and provide scholarships.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND WELFARE OF SPECIAL PERSONS since 2004-11-09

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT REFORMS TO PROMOTE THE EFFICIENCY AND PRODUCTIVITY OF SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL ACTIVITIES (STA)
rows.title_short: Financial Management Reform Act of Scientific and Technological Activities
rows.abstract: \"Financial Management Reform Act of Scientific and Technological Activities.\" The bill seeks to improve the system of operations in the procurement, accounting and auditing of science and technology activities. It requires the recommendation of the DOST Secretary before any fund could be released for research and development in the natural, agricultural, technological and engineering sciences to various agencies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CHAPTER 2, TITLE V OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Exempts the family home from real property tax.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM INTERNAL REVENUE TAXATION THE SEPARATION PAY, RETIREMENT PAY AND ALL MONETARY BENEFITS, HOWEVER DESIGNATED, OF EMPLOYEES WHO ARE SEPARATED FROM WORK FOR ANY CAUSE
rows.abstract: Aims to increase the take home pay of an employee who retires, resigns or is terminated by exempting his retirement pay and separation pay from taxes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE CEREALS RESEARCH, DEVELOPMENT AND EXTENSION INSTITUTE (PHILCEREAL), AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Philippine Cereals Research, Development and Extension Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Cereals Research, Development and Extension Act of 2004.\" The measure creates the Institute \"to transform the cereals sub-sector industry from being resource-based to technology-based.\" It seeks to expand the coverage of the Philippine Rice Research Institute to include other grains.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE, FOOD & FISHERIES since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH CERTAIN LIMITATIONS ON ADVERTISING RELATING TO CIGARETTES AND TOBACCO PRODUCTS
rows.title_short: Tobacco Products Control Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Tobacco Products Control Act of 2004.\" The bill prohibits the advertisement of cigarettes on the following: billboard within 500 meters of a school, student newspapers, taxis, buses, trains and their terminals, cinema or video games.
rows.status: Tabled by the Committee on 2005-04-26

rows.status: Substituted by HB04413

rows.author: C009
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A SPECIAL COMMITTEE TO REVIEW THE REVISED PENAL CODE, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill creates the Revised Penal Code Special Review Committee composed of the following: law professors from Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao; a member of the Integrated Bar of the Philippines, a retired Supreme Court Justice, and two from the private sector. It tasks the Committee to update the Penal Code by incorporating all amendatory laws.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C009
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING PROFESSIONAL LICENSE TO TEACHERS WHO HAVE RENDERED AT LEAST TWO (2)YEARS OF EFFICIENT SERVICE IN HIGH RISK AREAS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Special Professional License Privilege for Teachers in High Risk Areas
rows.abstract: \"Special Professional License Privilege for Teachers in High Risk Areas.\" The measure defines high risk areas as \"those places where terrorism, kidnapping and insurrection are common and identified by authorities as a sanctuary of rebels or where there are military operations.\" Grants license to non-licensed teachers who have served for two years in such areas.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C009
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A SEPARATE COMPENSATION SCHEME FOR LAWYER POSITIONS IN THE OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, THEREBY EXEMPTING THE SAID POSITIONS FROM REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6758, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE SALARY STANDARDIZATION LAW
rows.abstract: The bill exempts all lawyers in the Office of the Secretary of Justice including the Secretary, Undersecretaries, prosecutors, and the legal staff from the coverage of the Salary Standardization Law.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C009
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING BENEFITS PACKAGE FOR ALL BARANGAY TANODS IN THE COUNTRY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Tanod Benefit Package Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Tanod Benefit Package Act of 2004.\" The bill provides the following benefits to barangay tanods: insurance, honorarium, medical subsidy and scholarship for their children.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C009
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MANDATORY AND CONTINUING HUMAN RIGHTS EDUCATION FOR ALL BARANGAY TANODS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Mandatory and Continuing Human Rights Education Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Mandatory and Continuing Human Rights Education Act of 2004.\" The bill mandates the Commission on Human Rights to conduct regular education for barangay tanods about the Bill of Rights, Rules of Court on Arrest, and other laws on human rights.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D024
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-05-29, transmitted to on 2006-05-31 and received by the Senate on 2006-05-31
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 290 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill provides that persons engaged in the exploitation of national wealth shall remit 40% of their tax payments directly to the host local government and 60% to the national government.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05003

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 10(1) AND SECTION 11 OF REPUBLIC ACT 7156, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"MINI-HYDROELECTRIC POWER INCENTIVE ACT\"
rows.abstract: The bill provides for 60% of the special privilege tax collected from mini-hydroelectric power developers to be remitted directly to the host local government unit as its share and for the remaining 40% to be remitted to the national government.
rows.status: Consolidated into HB02744

rows.abstract: \"New Environmental and Sanitary Engineering Act of 2004.\" The measure creates the Board of Examiners for Environmental and Sanitary Engineers to issue certificates of registration for the practice of sanitary engineering. It provides for the powers and duties of the Board and the qualification of its members. It further provides for the requirements and qualifications of applicants to obtain a license.

rows.title_short: Pedestrian Safety Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Pedestrian Safety Act of 2004.\" The bill declares that all obstructions along roads and sidewalks are nuisances subject to summary abatement without need of judicial proceedings. Aims to solve road traffic, sidewalk congestion and hazards to pedestrians.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENTITLE CHILDREN OF TEACHERS AND EMPLOYEES IN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER LEARNING TO FREE TUITION AND OTHER SCHOOL FEES
rows.abstract: The bill grants teachers' and school employees' children studying in college 100% free tuition for the first child and 50% for the succeeding children.

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT SETTING ASIDE TWENTY-FIVE PERCENT (25%) OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS' CALAMITY FUNDS FOR PREPARATORY ACTIVITIES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill aims to use the Fund for future calamities to buy medicines, develop relocation centers, construct infrastructure and disseminate information to prevent death and damage to property.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMULGATING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL STANDARDS FOR DRINKING WATER, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Safe Drinking Water Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Safe Drinking Water Act of 2004.\" The bill creates a Drinking Water Quality Committee in every province to be composed of a representative from the Department of Health and the local health board.  The Board shall be tasked  to monitor potable water.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE INDUSTRIES, FACTORIES, COMPANIES, OR ANY INSTITUTION, FIRM OR ESTABLISHMENT USING CHEMICALS AND THEIR BY-PRODUCTS FOR PRODUCTION, TO DEVELOP AND PROMOTE A COMMUNITY ENVIRONMENT INFORMATION PROGRAM
rows.title_short: Community Environmental Information Program Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Community Environmental Information Program Act of 2004\".  The bill directs all industries, corporations, business firms and establishments that derive raw materials and those that produce and discard their by-products in the community, to ensure that their activities or operations do not pollute water and land bodies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PLANTING OF TREES IN OPEN SPACES OF SUBDIVISION PROJECTS DEVELOPED FOR RESIDENTIAL, INDUSTRIAL, OR COMMERCIAL PURPOSE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Greening Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Greening Act of 2004.\" The bill requires land developers to reserve at least 30% of the gross area to be developed as an open space for parks, playgrounds, recreational uses, schools, roads, churches and other similar amenities.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04074

rows.title_short: Environment Friendly Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Environment Friendly Act of 2004.\" The bill bans products which contain the following: chlorofluorocarbons or CFCs, styrofoam, aerosol propellants, freon, polycarbon plastic, polyethylene, polythene, vinyl, polyvinyl, phenolic vinyl, urethane, polyurethane, and similar extracts.

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SERVICE OF WARRANTS OF ARRESTS IN CERTAIN CASES AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.abstract: The bill prohibits the serving of warrant of arrest at night (from 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m.) holidays or weekends (12:00 p.m. Friday to 6:00 a.m. Sunday), except in cases of citizen's arrest, surveillance, entrapment, subversion, dangerous criminals, escapists or fugitives.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE CONSERVATION AND PROTECTION OF WILDLIFE RESOURCES AND THEIR HABITATS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act of 2004.\" The bill sets the guidelines on wildlife collection, possession, transportation, exportation, importation, introduction, re-stocking, bio-prospecting, scientific research, breeding, propagation, and conservation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT ALL LIQUOR PRODUCTS CARRY A WARNING LABEL THAT ALCOHOL INTAKE DURING PREGNANCY IS HAZARDOUS TO THE LIFE AND HEALTH OF THE UNBORN CHILD
rows.abstract: The bill imposes a fine ranging from PhP10,00 to PhP200,000 on liquor manufacturers and/or distributors who fail to print on the label of their liquor products a warning that alcohol intake is dangerous to the life and health of the unborn child.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROTECTION AND CONSERVATION OF ALL OBJECTS OF UNDERWATER CULTURAL HERITAGE IN PHILIPPINE WATERS
rows.title_short: Protection of Underwater Cultural Heritage Act of 2004.
rows.abstract: \"Protection of Underwater Cultural Heritage Act of 2004.\" Aims to protect and preserve underwater treasures by setting the requirement for archeology, exploration, excavation of shipwrecks and sunken vessels to those at least 100 years old.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 286 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the internal revenue liability of local government units (LGUs) to be automatically deducted from their respective revenue allotments to eliminate the unncessary transfer of money from the LGUs to the national treasury and back to the LGUs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT ADOPTING THE GROSS INCOME TAXATION FOR CORPORATIONS AND INDIVIDUALS ENGAGE IN TRADE OR BUSINESS AND/OR PRACTICE OF PROFESSION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PERTINENT PROVISIONS OF TITLE II OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill defines gross compensation income as \"all payments received in an employer-employee relationship like salaries, bonuses, allowances, ect.\" Defines gross income as \"gross sales or receipts derived from business or practice of a profession less sales returns, discounts, allowances, cost of goods or services or expenses incurred to produce the merchandize.\"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DISPOSAL AND/OR COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT OF CERTAIN MILITARY CAMPS AND RESERVATIONS, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE THE MILITARY REAL ESTATE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Military Real Estate Development Act
rows.abstract: \"MIlitary Real Estate Development Act.\" The bill creates the Authority to raise revenues for the AFP modernization by owning, holding, managing, developing, and disposing military real estate. Provides for the powers, duties and purposes of the Authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY INTO THE NATIONAL FOOD CORPORATION AND THE FOOD DEVELOPMENT AND REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION, REDEFINING THEIR POWERS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: National Food Authority Reorganization Act of 2003
rows.abstract: \"National Food Authority Reorganization Act of 2003.\" The bill creates the Corporation with a P15 billion capitalization to maintain and manage the annual rice reserve or buffer stock of the government.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-26

rows.title_short: Computer Education Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Computer Education Act of 2004.\" The bill aims to improve the skills of students by incorporating information technoloty in the curriculum of public elementary and high schools to make them more competitive.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C015
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE JOSE R. REYES MEMORIAL MEDICAL CENTER (JRRMMC) INTO A DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH (DOH) NATIONAL CENTER FOR TRAUMA, CANCER AND DERMATOLOGY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING A RATIONALIZED STAFFING PATTERN FOR THE SUPPORT STAFF OF PROVINCIAL/CITY PROSECUTORS OFFICE
rows.abstract: E.O. 910 issued on September 22, 1983 rationalized the salaries of provincial or city fiscals' offices and adopted a standard staffing pattern for the support staff. The bill seeks to provide for an updated staffing pattern for each prosecutors' office since E.O. 910 has become obsolete.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING GOVERNMENT-OWNED OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS (GOCCs)ON THE PRIVATIZATION PROGRAM TO RESERVE AT LEAST TWENTY PERCENT (20%) OF THEIR TOTAL INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING (IPO) OF SHARES TO OVERSEAS WORKERS, AUTHORIZING THE OVERSEAS WORKERS INVESTMENT (OWI) FUND UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7111 TO MANAGE AN INVESTMENT FUND PORTFOLIO FOR OVERSEAS WORKERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill provides investment opportunities and incentives to overseas workers and their families by allowing them and their beneficiaries to buy stocks from an investment fund \"that will manage their money under a trust fund.\"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8291, AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1146, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"REVISED GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE ACT OF 1977,\" AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill provides that \"all service credited for retirement, resignation or separation where corresponding benefits have been awarded shall be included in the computation of service in case of reinstatement and subsequent retirement or separation.\"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C002
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A NATIONAL LAND USE POLICY, PROVIDING THE IMPLEMENTING MECHANISMS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: National Land Use Act of the Philippines
rows.abstract: \"National Land Use Act of the Philippines.\" The bill provides for national land use classification, planning, zoning guidelines and standards. Reconstitutes the National Land Use Committee into the Land Use Policy Administration and prescribes its powers and functions. Classifies lands into agricultural, alienable and disposable, forest, timber, watershed, coastal and mineral. Sets the criteria for the development of settlement, tourism and industrial areas and infrastructure.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on 2005-06-01

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on 2005-06-01
committee_action.remarks: consolidated bill approved subject to refinement.amendment and for referral to the Committee on Appropriations

rows.author: C002
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REGULATE AND MODERNIZE THE PRACTICE OF CHEMISTRY IN THE PHILIPPINES, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 754
rows.title_short: Chemistry Law of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Chemistry Law of 2004.\" The bill updates the Chemistry Law (RA 754, June 18, 1952). Defines chemistry as \"the study, analysis, modification and calculation of physicochemical and biochemical properties of matter including atomic, molecular and supra-molecular composition and structure, the changes it undergoes, energy involved and conditions it occur.\" Provides for the scope of the professional practice of chemistry, creates the Board, and prescribes its composition, powers and duties, and the qualifications of its members. Provides for the requirements for the board examination, issuance of certificated of registration and permits.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING THE NEGATIVE PORTRAYAL OF A PERSON WITH A DISABILITY IN MOVIES, TELEVISION, STAGE AND OTHER FORMS OF MASS COMMUNICATION
rows.title_short: Media Protection for the Disabled Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Media Protection for the Disabled Act of 2004.\" The bill declares it unlawful to mock, embarass, humiliate, or insult a disabled person in mass media.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING PUBLIC RECREATIONAL PARKS IN MAJOR URBAN AREAS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill states that there are few public parks in major urban areas where workers can enjoy and rest without spending money and cites the need for them.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MODERNIZATION OF THE NATIONAL MAPPING AND RESOURCE INFORMATION AUTHORITY (NAMRIA), AMENDING CERTAIN PORTIONS OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 192, SECTION 22(a) AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: NAMRIA Modernization Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"NAMRIA Modernization Act of 2004.\" The bill cites the need for fresh funds to upgrade NAMRIA's facilities.  Prescribes the objectives, mandate, responsibilities, powers and functions of the NAMRIA and the components for its modernization.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES STOCK EXCHANGE
rows.title_short: Small and Medium Enterprises Stock Exchange (SAEX) Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Small and Medium Enterprises Stock Exchange (SMEX) Act of 2004.\" The bill defines a small enterprise as \"any business with a capitalization of P2 million to P20 million while a medium enterprise has a capitalization of P21 million to P100 million. Aims to provide funds for the SMEX by requiring their public listing at a stock exchange.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE USE OF RECYCLABLE OR BIODEGRADABLE MATERIALS FOR THE PACKAGING OF CONSUMER PRODUCTS
rows.abstract: Grants tax incentives to manufacturers who use recyclable and biodegradable packaging for their consumer goods.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-02-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROTECTING THE RIGHTS OF CELLULAR PHONE SUBSCRIBERS
rows.title_short: Cellular Phone Subscribers Protection Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Cellular Phone Subscribers Protection Act of 2004.\" The bill provides that phone calls shall be charged based on actual time consumed by a caller rather than by minute increment and that drop calls shall not be charged to subscribers. Creates the subscribers Protection Office to protect cell phone owners.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05283

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE, DEVELOP AND ASSIST MICRO AND COTTAGE INDUSTRIES BY PROVIDING AN EFFECTIVE AND RATIONAL SYSTEM TO ADDRESS THEIR PRODUCTION AND TECHNOLOGY NEEDS
rows.title_short: Micro and Cottage Industries Development Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Micro and Cottage Industries Development Act of 2004.\" Designates the Cottage Industry Technology Center as the lead agency to help cottage industry increase their productivity and ensure their survival.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05811

rows.author: C130
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND PROVIDING FOR THE RATIONALIZATION OF WAGE LEVELS ON A NATIONAL OR INDUSTRIAL BASIS
rows.abstract: The bill abolishes the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board and replaces it with the National Wages and Productivity Commission which shall determine and fix national minimum wage rates according to industries and issue the corresponding wage order.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING PENSIONS UNDER THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM TO A MINIMUM LEVEL OF TWELVE THOUSAND PESOS (P12,000.00) UNDER AN ECONOMIC ADJUSTMENT PENSION PROGRAM
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to increase the monthly pay of GSIS pensioners from a minimum level of P1,400 to P6,000 increasing annually by P1,000 until it reaches P12,000.

rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE APPOINTMENT OF A REPRESENTATIVE FOR THE ELDERLY IN EVERY SANGGUNIANG BARANGAY, SANGGUNIANG BAYAN, SANGGUNIANG PANLUNSOD AND SANGGUNIANG PANLALAWIGAN
rows.abstract: The bill aims to harness the talents, wisdom and experience of senior citizens by appointing an elderly as a representative in every sangguniang barangay, bayan, panglungsod and panlalawigan.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING AN AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTIVITY ENHANCEMENT FUND, IN EACH PROVINCE, CITY AND MUNICIPALITY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE

rows.title_full: AN ACT DIRECTING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION, CULTURE AND SPORTS TO INCLUDE IN THE CURRICULUM OF ALL SECONDARY AND COLLEGIATE SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES IN THE COUNTRY THE TEACHING OF POPULATION AND ENVIRONMENTAL DEVELOPMENT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill requires the teaching of population and environment development in the secondary and college levels to help students realize the relationships between overpopulation and poverty.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTALL FAX MACHINE UNITS IN ALL CITIES AND MUNICIPALITIES IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: The bill aims to solve the communication barrier between the local and national governments by installing fax machines nationwide.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2005-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING VOLUNTARY BLOOD DONATION, PROVIDING FOR AN ADEQUATE SUPPLY OF SAFE BLOOD, REGULATING BLOOD BANKS AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.title_short: Blood Services Act of 1992
rows.abstract: \"Blood Services Act of 1992.\" The bill aims to make blood readily available to hospitals and patients by creating the National Blood Services Program under the Department of Health, Philippine National Red Cross, and the Philippine Blood Coordinating Council which shall establish blood collection centers nationwide.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE TRANSFER OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY AND THE PRACTICE OF PROFESSIONS IN THE PHILIPPINES BY OVERSEAS FILIPINO PROFESSIONALS
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to allow overseas Filipino professionals to practice here in the Philippines to enable them to concretely assist in the country's development processes, notably in the areas of transfer and exchange of technology.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING PARENTS, ADOPTERS, GUARDIANS OR PERSONS EXERCISING SPECIAL OR SUBSTITUTE PARENTAL AUTHORITY OVER CHILDREN UNDER PARENTAL AUTHORITY FOUND TO BE ENGAGED IN BEGGING AND/OR PROSTITUTION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Parental Sanction Law for Child Begging and Prostitution
rows.abstract: \"Parental Sanction Law for Child Begging and Prostitution.\" The bill imposes the penalty of prision correccional to parents, adopters, guardians or substitute parents who shall use, coerce, intimidate or force their children to beg or become prostitutes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES TO HOLD TWO (2)OR MORE FULL TIME POSITIONS IN THE GOVERNMENT OR ANY SUBDIVISION, AGENCY OR INSTURMENTALITY THEREOF INCLUDING GOVERNMENT- OWNED OR CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS OR IN PRIVATE ENTITIES AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill prohibits public servants to hold dual government positions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-03
